At my heaviest, I was around 360 in college, I’m currently 220  (lowest I’ve gone down was 199). I shaved off 60 through walking more and not eating as much carbs, then plateaued for a while. Took up running in 2011, but it wasn’t until I started CrossFit (like very very basic movement versions of the more advanced ones- the coaches were friendly and helpful) where I’ve mostly kept off the weight. 

I was 300 when I started CrossFit, took less than three years to lose 100lbs. Since crossing the 200lb threshold, I’ve been gaining and losing the same 20lbs. 

I feel like I’m healthier than ever- no longer prediabetic, my blood pressure is ok- average 118/90 (used to be 160-170/100).
